# Third-party notices — NIDO

<!-- Generated by scripts/third-party-notices.mjs from package-lock.json and the
     license files in node_modules. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run notices`. -->

NIDO (MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)) is built with the open-source packages below. Their code is compiled into the app, so their copyright notices and license texts travel with it; the same list is readable inside the app (About → Licenses).

The list covers every package that `package-lock.json` does not mark as development-only. It is a superset of what ends up in the APK: some of them are build tools that Expo needs at compile time (for example `lightningcss`, MPL-2.0) and are not shipped.

AI models and knowledge packs are not part of the app: they are downloaded separately and keep their own licenses (see [ATTRIBUTION.md](ATTRIBUTION.md) and `docs/release/MODEL_LICENSE_AUDIT.md`). Android libraries resolved by Gradle at build time (AndroidX, Kotlin) are not listed here yet.

Source: `package-lock.json sha256:752e3ec044fb` · 584 packages.

> **Partial list:** generated without `node_modules`, so the license texts are missing. Run `npm ci && npm run notices`.

## License elections

- **node-forge** is offered under `(BSD-3-Clause OR GPL-2.0)`; NIDO uses it under **BSD-3-Clause**. NIDO is MIT-licensed; the BSD-3-Clause option keeps it permissive.
